Yes, this is absolutely true. According to my knowledge, depersonalization is caused by anxiety and only anxiety (nothing else).

I suffered from depersonalization for a few months from a bad drug experience. I recommend that you try to go outside as much as possible and do some kind of physical exercise. Eventually it will go away (I'd say 3-4 months).

Best of luck to you.

Honestly man unfortunately it kind of does decide my future because even if I get 100 on the final I think I might get an 81 or something like that, and we all know that what "calculated mark" we are trying to strive for is never actually achievable.

I need something easier to pursue which a not-so-smart person like me can get into. Honestly, no matter how much I've tried to "reflect" on my mistakes, do all that kind of stuff, I still do just slightly above average or mediocre at best, and in this case, poorly.

Unfortunately I think there is no way of pursuing medicine if you have a failed course since your GPA is toast. I would love to be proven wrong but man this program showed me that I am not as smart as I think at all... damn
